Hi Rajiv —

Thanks for the time on the call this morning. As discussed, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that maps the security/compliance gates we expect to clear during the eval and what evidence we need to sign off. The three primary gates are:

- SOC 2 attestation (scope: hosting + inference runtime)
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire (security control mapping + sample evidence)
- DPA signature + data retention alignment (EU residency carveouts noted inline)

Proposed timeline: 3–4 weeks from receipt of evidence to acceptance, with an evidence review call in week 2. Key asks for your team:

1) Confirm SOC 2 scope (we've proposed "hosting + inference" — please flag any exclusion).
2) Provide access to your security contact for the SIG spreadsheet (we attached a starter).
3) Review the DPA redline; we propose DocuSign for signature once redlines are agreed.

I've included the MAP workbook (CentauriPay_MAP_v1.xlsx), our latest SOC 2 attestation (SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf), a DPA redline (DPA_redline_v1.docx), and a partially completed SIG/CAIQ to accelerate intake.

Attachments: CentauriPay_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf (attestation), DPA_redline_v1.docx (our redline), SIG-CAIQ_partial.xlsx

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm SOC 2 scope and point security owner (by EOD Mon).
- We schedule an evidence review call (30–45m) week of Mar 22.

If that works, I’ll update the MAP with owners/ETA and send an invite.

Best,

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick clarifications before we lock the owners and call: 

1) Retention: our legal team needs to confirm the EU residency option you indicated. Is the proposed retention window (90 days logs, 13 months transactional) configurable per-tenant? We need that spelled out in the DPA annex.

2) SOC 2 scope: can you confirm whether backup/DR infrastructure is included in the attestation you sent? The attestation PDF we have looks like platform-only; our SOC contact (cc’d) needs confirmation of the inference runtime coverage (model serving layer) specifically.

3) Encryption: we need a short note on key management — do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK) or only Redwood-managed KMS? If BYOK is available, what KMS vendors are supported?

4) SIG: the spreadsheet is helpful; please confirm whether you expect us to return the completed SIG or if Redwood will fill sections and mark evidence ownership.

Regarding timing: week of Mar 22 is tight for us given internal calendar but possible; can we look at the week of Apr 5 for the evidence review call? That gives our security team time to triage.

Attaching a short list of internal owners:
- Rajiv Mehta — Head, Platform Security (primary)
- Clive Turner — Director, Legal Ops (DPA owner)

I'll await the answers on scope/backup, KMS, and retention so we can finalize the MAP.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security exit criteria & evidence timeline (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Rajiv — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers inline below; attaching a filled-in SIG starter and a short KMS note.

1) Retention: our platform supports per-tenant retention windows. The MAP workbook includes the retention fields we propose; summary:
   - Logs: configurable, default 90 days, selectable to 400+ days for committed enterprise contracts.
   - Transactional artifacts (indexable events): default 13 months; can be shortened to 6 months for EU-only residency setups.
   - Exportable snapshots: available on request and can be preserved for a contractually agreed term.

2) SOC 2 scope: the attached SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf covers the control set for our hosting and the inference runtime (we perform periodic control testing for model-serving components). For operational artifacts (backup/DR) we have a separate DR statement; summary attached as "DR-summary.txt" in the SIG workbook. If you need the full DR attestation, we can queue that as an evidentiary item.

3) Encryption / KMS: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (BYOK). Supported KMS integrations: AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault. BYOK setup is part of the Private deployment onboarding (or Dedicated contracts) — for hosted customers we provide envelope encryption with customer KMS options for higher-tier contracts.

4) SIG spreadsheet: we expect CentauriPay to return the SIG with primary answers for items owned by your control plane, and Redwood will fill our sections + link to evidence. Attached: SIG-CAIQ_partial.xlsx (we've completed the Redwood-owned columns and added evidence links).

Next: Soojin will update the MAP workbook with the retention carveouts and DPA owner info. Once Clive confirms DPA signing authority and we agree redline items, we'll send a DocuSign link.

Attachments: SIG-CAIQ_partial.xlsx, KMS-support-note.txt (brief), CentauriPay_MAP_v1_filled_owners.xlsx (MAP with owners)

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Applied ML Ops, Redwood Inference
